bannerlord148.name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord (CBATH test)
bannerlord148.description: Bannerlord v1.4.8.119303 for CBATH. Framework modules (Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx, MCMv5) MUST appear before Native in the load order - ButterLib/UIExtenderEx/MCM abort module loading with a 'is loaded after the Native!' warning dialog otherwise. CombatBrain is the temporary subject under test; CustomBattle is required to reach a real battle mission.
